question: Find one audited realized-vs-claimed figure for a production AI or ML auto-close / straight-through-processing programme (2021+): inspector-general or supreme-audit reviews of AI pilots (e.g. State Dept declassification follow-up, IRS or SSA ML triage, NAO reviews of DWP or HMRC machine-learning risk models), to replace the RPA analogy for r_C
conclusion_affected: r_C range (C_UPPER_FIELD borrows the HUD/GSA RPA range); whether A01 routing keeps 2 or 5 modal processes at m = 1.77
rationale: r_C is the only factor still borrowed by analogy from technology programmes that are not AI. Under the RPA analogy A01 routing falls from 5 to 2 modal large-national processes (P03, P07); a sourced r_C at 0.75 or above would leave 5

question: Split h evidence into production vs ex-ante: for CB-02 (bank test set-up, ~20%), CB-04 (OCBC benchmark), E19 (optimal-policy simulation) and CB-05 (State production self-report), record whether each is measured in production, and rerun with a realization factor on every non-production anchor instead of on h above 0.50 only
conclusion_affected: Choice between C_UPPER_FIELD (h above 0.50 only) and C_ALL_FIELD (whole h); C_ALL_FIELD removes every routing modal process
rationale: The lower half of the A01 h range is also test-set-up, benchmark or optimal-policy evidence. Cutting the whole of h by the RPA range takes routing to 0 modal processes at every m, so the split point matters more than r_C's shape

question: Evidence on the correlation of realization across interventions within one organisation: from the HUD and GSA OIG RPA audits and NAO casework audits, check whether the same unit's programmes over- or under-delivered together (bot-level realization by office; DWP TCR by year against other DWP efficiency lines), to bound the rank correlation used in the copula
conclusion_affected: Rank correlation of r_A, r_B, r_D (0 to 1 swept); size of B's loss and C's gain under correlation
rationale: Correlation moves B's rank-first probability from 0.181 to 0.141 and C's from 0.200 to 0.235 (A01 routing, m = 1.77, A_FIELD x BD_FIELD) but changes at most 2 large-national modal winners in the A_FIELD cells. No source fixes the correlation

question: Per-process (not per-sponsor) realization: rerun with r_B and r_D drawn per process with a sponsor factor plus process-specific noise (hierarchical copula), since HUD bot-level ratios ranged 0.01-0.33 within one programme
conclusion_affected: Modal winners under BD_FIELD; whether the sponsor-level draw (one r per draw for all 15 processes) overstates ranking volatility
rationale: All realization factors (r_A, r_B, r_C, r_D) are drawn once per sponsor draw and applied to every process. HUD's per-bot ratios (0.01, 0.11, 0.33) show within-programme dispersion that this structure ignores

question: Propagate the routing realization result into the routing and A-recut notes: add the C_UPPER_FIELD modal counts (A01 routing m = 1.77: 2 of 15 at a large national; hybrid: 5) next to every statement that A01 routing is modal in 5 processes, after independent validation
conclusion_affected: g0403-01 §0 and §4; g0401-g0502 routing note; strategic synthesis AI paragraph
rationale: Those notes state routing's 5 modal processes at m = 1.77 with the h-asymmetry caveat; this study replaces the caveat with a number
